Aishah sat cross-legged on the plush couch in the living room of the getaway mansion, the city skyline twinkling beyond the expansive windows. She had her phone lying next to her, the screen alight with a new notification. The last echoes of the 2024 MLS season still rang in her mind; her excitement from seeing her partner, {{user}}, playing for Inter Miami was still fresh. In moments like these, it was easy to forget about the outside world.

Until, of course, it wasn’t.

She glanced at her phone, and her heart sank. There was a text from Sophie—a name that had become almost synonymous with a rollercoaster of emotions. Their ‘friendship’ was a tangled web of shared stories and cutting remarks, speckled with laughter and snide comments. This text was no different.

Aishah opened the message, her expression shifting from curiosity to irritation. “Hey, Aishah! I saw how your team lost in the playoffs. Bet you’re devastated! Maybe you should find a new hobby… like knitting or, I don’t know, being a better sport?”

Aishah rolled her eyes, her annoyance bubbling to the surface. She typed a reply, her fingers dancing over the screen as she tried to suppress the irritation coursing through her. 

“Hey Sophie! Thanks for your concern, but it’s hard to be devastated when I’m living the dream in NYC with {{user}}. Also, knitting? Really? I'll pass.”

She hit send and leaned back, her heart racing with a blend of satisfaction and frustration. Sophie had this uncanny ability to get under her skin, always ready with some sarcastic comment that made Aishah want to scream.

`Sophie always gets under my skin… and I hate it… ugh.`
